title: Adjustment Treatment
adjustment: Outstanding salary ₹5,000 (not yet paid at year-end)

effects.heading: Effect in Trading & P&L A/c
effects.text: Added to Salary on the debit side of the Profit & Loss Account, so the salary expense shows the full amount incurred for the year.

effects.heading: Effect in Balance Sheet
effects.text: Shown as a current liability under *Outstanding Expenses*, because the amount is owed but not yet paid on the balance sheet date.
